arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
printf 'VPS_PASSIVE_PREFLIGHT_START\n'
printf 'USER=%s\n' "$(id -un)"
uname -s
if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then echo SUDO_NONINTERACTIVE=AVAILABLE; else echo SUDO_NONINTERACTIVE=UNAVAILABLE; fi
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null; then echo SYSTEMD=AVAILABLE; else echo SYSTEMD=NOT_FOUND; fi
echo SERVICE_UNIT_NAMES
systemctl list-unit-files --all --type=service --no-pager --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'supervisor|project.leader|codex|telegram' || :
echo TIMER_UNIT_NAMES
systemctl list-unit-files --all --type=timer --no-pager --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'supervisor|project.leader|codex|telegram' || :
echo SUPERVISOR_PROCESS_MATCHES
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
matches=[]
for name in os.listdir('/proc'):
 if not name.isdigit(): continue
 try:
  argv=open('/proc/'+name+'/cmdline','rb').read(12000).replace(b'\0',b' ').decode('utf-8','replace')
 except (OSError,PermissionError): continue
 if 'supervisor_live' not in argv and 'passive_supervisor' not in argv: continue
 if any(x in argv for x in ('VPS_PASSIVE_PREFLIGHT_START', 'capture_process_scenario', 'SSH ', 'git clone')):continue
 if 'bash -lc' in argv: continue
 matches.append(name)
print('RESIDENT_SUPERVISOR_PROCESS_COUNT='+str(len(matches)))
PY
echo RELEVANT_DEPLOYMENT_ROOTS
for p in /opt/project-leader-supervisor /srv/project-leader-supervisor /home/ubuntu/VPS /root/VPS /opt/VPS /srv/VPS /home/ubuntu/Project-leader-codex /home/ubuntu/project-leader-codex /root/project-secrets /etc/systemd/system; do
 if test -d "$p"; then printf 'EXISTS=%s\n' "$p"; fi
done
echo SUPERVISOR_RELATED_FILES
sudo -n python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
roots=['/etc/systemd/system','/etc/cron.d','/opt','/srv','/home/ubuntu','/root/project-secrets']
for root in roots:
 p=Path(root)
 if not p.exists():continue
 try:
  entries=list(p.iterdir())[:200]
 except (OSError,PermissionError):continue
 for e in entries:
  n=e.name.lower()
  if any(w in n for w in ('supervisor','codex','project-leader','project_leader')):
   print('TOP_PATH='+str(e))
PY
echo REA_RUNTIME_HEALTH
test -x /home/ubuntu/rea-final-runtime/bin/rea-mcp && echo REA_MCP_PRESENT=YES
echo VPS_PASSIVE_PREFLIGHT_FINISHED
